top_signals.title: Algebris Hedges Against AT1 Volatility by Avoiding Tight Spreads
top_signals.summary: Algebris Investments is taking a cautious approach to AT1 bonds as spreads remain historically tight, avoiding the most expensive parts of the market and keeping buffers against a potential downturn. Other investors remain positive on the asset class, arguing that banks are well capitalized and that even French lenders remain fundamentally sound despite political and sovereign-market volatility. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Carlyle and Orlen Team Up to Hunt for Energy Deals Across Europe
top_signals.summary: Global investment firm Carlyle and the largest energy company in central Europe, Poland’s Orlen, on Thursday agreed to jointly explore investment opportunities in the energy sector across in Poland, Europe, and internationally. The two firms signed a memorandum of understanding at the seventh ministerial meeting of the Partnership for Transatlantic Energy Cooperation (P-TEC) in Warsaw, Poland, on Thursday. Building a joint pipeline of energy investment projects, strengthening Europe’s energy security, and boosting industrial competitiveness…
